item.title: Zetwerk Manufacturing Business IPO price band set at Rs 143–151; Rs 5,012 crore issue opens on October 15
item.description: Zetwerk Manufacturing Business has set its IPO price band at Rs 143–151 per share for its Rs 5,012.33-crore issue opening on October 15. The offering includes a fresh issue of Rs 2,830 crore. Proceeds will primarily fund debt repayment and strategic acquisitions to support its expansion.

item.title: Premier Energies shares in focus after Q2 update reveals fresh orders worth Rs 4,000 crore
item.description: Premier Energies received orders worth Rs 4,001 crore in the July–September quarter for solar cell and module supplies and EPC projects. Its manufacturing capacity expanded to 11.1 GW for modules and 10.6 GW for solar cells, following a 7 GW TOPCon facility commissioning in Andhra Pradesh.

item.title: HFCL among 3 stocks closing above VWAP
item.description: Three Nifty 500 stocks closed more than 2% above their respective volume-weighted average prices (VWAPs) on October 9, according to StockEdge’s technical scan.
